connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -9.851) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm) touching the radiating edge y=-3.251 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

US3_MS3.slots_polygon_mm: x extent +-2.2 -> +-3.5 mm (arms move outward, arm width t, base y, Lu unchanged)
US3_MS3.note: Single design variable: U outer width. Patch L/W, Lu, t, y0, feed (50 ohm line + 0.80 x 6.60 mm transformer), material, board, port and mesh profile unchanged.

rationale: Owner HFSS sweep 2026-11-13 of US3_MS3 patch_L 6.402-6.502 mm: the -10 dB band only shifts (about -8 MHz per +0.01 mm) and keeps ~350 MHz width; HFSS and openEMS (024) show no Smith-chart loop and no second Re(Zin) peak in 5.5-10.5 GHz, so the U mode lies above 10.5 GHz. Crude one-point scaling (GUIDE_MODEL, not EM): US2 (probe, Lu 3.2, U mean length 9.2 mm) showed a second Re(Zin) peak at 10.36 GHz; U mean length 2(Lu-t/2)+(Wu-t) goes 8.1 -> 10.7 mm with Wu 7.0, which by inverse scaling puts the U mode near 8.9 GHz. The patch mode is also expected to drop because the wider U cuts more current.
purpose: Bring the U-slot resonance down toward the channel so that it adds a second resonance to the patch mode (bandwidth), instead of the single-resonance response of US3_MS3.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Base mesh: a second resonance (local Re(Zin) maximum >= 20 ohm or a Smith-chart loop) appears between 8.24 and 10.5 GHz, i.e. the U mode moved down from > 10.5 GHz.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: Base mesh: the contiguous -10 dB band is wider than US3_MS3 base (023: 7.800-8.170 GHz, 370 MHz, 5 MHz sampling), wherever it sits.
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 and H2 true -> next round recentres on the channel with patch_L only (rate from the owner's HFSS sweep). H1 true, H2 false -> the two modes are too far apart or badly coupled: next variable Lu or y0. H1 false -> the scaling model is wrong; report and stop the Wu path.

mesh_hint_note: Hard y line at -0.215 mm (inside the U-slot base, metal-free): microstrip_edge_qw adds plain y lines across the slot (<= 0.3 mm), which without this hint gave a y grading ratio 1.507 > 1.5 near y -0.37..-0.07 mm. Found by prepare-only trials (round 23).
